definition: A remembered experience, especially one recalled with strong feeling.
author: Leo Tolstoy
quote: “And I tell you—I did make an offer and was rejected, and Katerina Alexandrovna is nothing now to me but a painful and humiliating reminiscence.”
example_sentence: Every reunion turns into an evening of reminiscence.
